text:
Situation: Olanzapine 10 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current stock provides 11.7 to 28.8 days of supply across three sites. The primary labeler for our current NDC (33342008411) is Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited, manufactured at a plant in India (FEI 3007517881).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records show that plant received Official Action Indicated (OAI) classifications after inspections ending 2017-11-24 and 2021-11-01. FDA recall records show three recalls for olanzapine from that plant: a Class II recall initiated 2022-02-16 (D-0639-2022) for 10 mg tablets; a Class II recall initiated 2024-11-25 (D-0154-2025) for 2.5 mg tablets; and a Class III recall initiated 2026-08-27 (D-0867-2026) for 5 mg tablets, all for cGMP deviations or failed impurity specifications.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term but dependent on a manufacturer with a repeated FDA compliance history. We should qualify alternative sources now to avoid future disruption.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Alkermes, Inc. as the first-ranked alternate and execute a test purchase pending P&T committee approval of formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate Apotex Corp., Ascend Laboratories, LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, and Bionpharma Inc. as secondary alternates pending P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to report qualification status and pricing to P&T committee at the next scheduled meeting.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
